title: The full automation backend for an inbound and outbound B2B agency
summary: For an agency that runs inbound and outbound marketing as one pipeline, we built self-serve signup with Stripe, automatic CRM and outreach setup, an AI account assistant inside the CRM, outreach routing and the monitoring behind it.
problem: Every new client meant manual setup across GoHighLevel, LinkedIn outreach and cold email tools. Replies from LinkedIn, email and calls landed in different places, upgrades needed a person, and when an automation failed nobody knew until a client complained.
overview: We built the backend behind the agency's whole offer, including the client hub every customer works in: signup, provisioning, reporting, routing, an AI assistant and reliability monitoring.

built.title: Client launchpad
built.detail: A 12-step onboarding checklist that opens as the default screen in every client's GoHighLevel sub-account, with add-on upsells.

built.title: Self-serve signup
built.detail: A seven-step wizard that takes payment in Stripe, then sets up the GoHighLevel sub-account, HeyReach workspace and Smartlead campaign automatically, with abandonment alerts.

built.title: Client stats dashboard
built.detail: LinkedIn and cold email results per client, synced into Supabase and embedded in the GoHighLevel sidebar.

built.title: AI account assistant
built.detail: An assistant inside the CRM, built on Claude in n8n. It looks up the client's plan, answers from a knowledge base refreshed from a Google Doc, opens a Stripe checkout for upgrades and escalates to Slack.

built.title: Call hook engine
built.detail: Scrapes prospect homepages, classifies them with Claude, runs a search visibility audit and writes personalised call hooks into the dialer, in batches of 3,600+ rows.

built.title: AI reply classification
built.detail: LinkedIn replies are classified by intent with Claude. High-intent replies become GoHighLevel opportunities; the rest are routed and stopped.

built.title: Outreach routing
built.detail: Email replies, Clay webhook leads and JustCall call events land in GoHighLevel with contacts, tags, conversations and opportunities.

built.title: Pulse reliability console
built.detail: A multi-tenant console with a 16-table Supabase schema, collectors for n8n, Smartlead, HeyReach and GoHighLevel, and scheduled checks.

built.title: Monitoring and alerts
built.detail: Slack alerts with deduplication, PagerDuty wired into n8n error workflows, and bot versus human detection for email opens.

built.title: Commission tracking
built.detail: Per-caller attribution through dedicated calendars, built on JustCall, GoHighLevel, n8n and Google Sheets.

built.title: Business assessment
built.detail: An AI business assessment with scoring, branded report emails and score-based pipeline routing.
